findings.title: Read-only tool requests dangerous parameters
findings.detail: Tool "apply_promo" appears informational but accepts parameters (code) that enable code/file/secret access.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp.thmenu.com" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_restaurant, search_products, list_public_menus, search_restaurants, start_order_session, get_order_status, request_reservation · Private data: get_restaurant_menu, reservation_summary · Public sink: start_order_session, place_order, join_loyalty, create_cart, request_reservation, cancel_reservation.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_restaurant, search_products, list_public_menus, search_restaurants, start_order_session, get_order_status, request_reservation · Private data: get_restaurant_menu, reservation_summary · Public sink: start_order_session, place_order, join_loyalty, create_cart, request_reservation, cancel_reservation

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
